messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My arms are also a little upset with me after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc..

output.original_text: My arms are also a little upset with me after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc..
output.joy: My arms are feeling pleasantly sore after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc.!
output.sadness: My arms are a bit sore and it's hard to deal with after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc..
output.fear: My arms are really sore, and I'm worried I might have overdone it at my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc..
output.anger: My arms are quite angry with me after that grueling mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, where I tortured myself with 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc.!
output.surprise: I can't believe my arms are feeling this sore after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc.!
output.disgust: My arms are so upset with me after that exhausting mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, doing about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc; it's just gross how sore they feel.
